applicabilityBasis.summary: steakUSDC is the Morpho Vault V2 lending-vault share at ethereum:0xbeef088055857739c12cd3765f20b7679def0f51, denominated in USDC. The exact product materials describe variable-rate lending; protocol documentation describes receipt tokens, interest accrual and adapter asset reporting. Share value varies with the strategy position. Withdrawals use available underlying digital assets; the general framework also describes in-kind exits into protocol positions, subject to configuration and gates. The reviewed terms do not identify an obligor promising fixed national-currency redemption for each share. These share rights support non-payment-token under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Reviewed on 2026-10-07 as a yield-accruing strategy-vault receipt, separate from underlying USDC. Carniceria Tropical SA, Panama, is disclosed as the service operator and vault curator, wholly owned by Steakhouse Financial Ltd. The terms disclaim being a party to protocol transactions or an obligation to deliver cryptoassets; they do not establish a separate legal issuer or fixed monetary redemption obligor for this share. issuerEntity is omitted. Parent-token licenses, GENIUS intent, reserve reports and enforcement are not transferred to the vault share. This assessment concerns the payment-stablecoin authorization model and does not determine securities classification or exempt every service involving the vault.
